questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: Kurserne var generelt nemmere end på KU men der er mere arbejde pga mange afleveringer.

questions.answer: Mange afleveringer i løbet af semesteret hvor KU har afsluttende opgaver.

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
INFO1110: Introduction to Programming
DATA1001: Foundations of Data Science
EDUH4058: Sport and Learning in Australian Culture
MKTG1001: Marketing Principles

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: EDUH4058: Sport and Learning in Australian Culture var et fantastisk kursus. Man tager ud og oplever australske sportsgrene med andre udvekslingsstuderende og opgaverne er utrolig nemme.

questions.answer: Spillede volleyball og lidt fodbold

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag på stranden og surf. Det bliver ikke bedre end en tur på stranden og nyde det gode vejr.

questions.answer: Jervis Bay, Royal National Park, Blue mountains, Magnetic Island, Whitsundays, Cairns

questions.answer: Det var relativt nemt. Australiere er meget søde og åbne.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Det er lidt svært men opsøg dem i de kurser du har.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Deres forkærlighed for stranden.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Oplev den australske natur
Nyd stranden
Barbecues på stranden

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sørg for at opleve den australske natur også inde i Sydney.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At man møder så mange nye mennesker og at man kan få lov til at rejse rundt i så smukt et land og opleve så mange ting.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At finde balance mellem at studere og nyde ens ophold.

questions.answer: Yes
